name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.service.InConferenceService
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation starts this service while a meeting is active to listen for live meeting messages. It syncs the current whiteboard state for a new participant and rejects another incoming call while the user is already in a meeting.
disableEffect: Late participants may not receive the current whiteboard state, and incoming meeting requests may not be handled correctly.
